patterns.name: Container Image Lifecycle Security Management
patterns.description: Old Docker images in container registries pose security risks from accumulated CVEs and outdated dependencies. Unmaintained images are attack vectors similar to legacy cloud systems.
patterns.evidence: Checkout.com security incident (1,596 HN score) - legacy third-party cloud file storage system from 2020 not properly decommissioned. Attackers gained unauthorized access. Same principle applies to Docker image registries.

strategies: Automated cleanup of images >180 days old

applicability_to_chained.justification: Chained has 13 Cloud Run services with historical Docker images in Artifact Registry. Legacy images from early development may contain CVEs. Automated cleanup and scanning directly applicable.
applicability_to_chained.implementation: LOW complexity - 1-2 days for audit and cleanup script
applicability_to_chained.impact: HIGH - 80% reduction in vulnerable image attack surface

actionable_next_steps: Run: gcloud artifacts docker images list to inventory all images
Enable: Artifact Registry vulnerability scanning
Create: tools/docker_image_cleanup.py script
Implement: Retention policy (delete images >180 days old)
Document: Image lifecycle management process

patterns.name: Container Infrastructure Component Deprecation Risk
patterns.description: Even mature, widely-used container ecosystem components can deprecate with limited notice (6-12 months). Dependencies require active monitoring and migration planning.
patterns.evidence: Kubernetes Ingress NGINX retirement (107 HN score) - Kubernetes SIG Network announcing retirement. Best-effort maintenance until March 2026, then no more releases, bugfixes, or security updates. Affects thousands of deployments.

strategies: Dependency tracking dashboard with EOL dates
Subscribe to GCP Cloud Run release notes
tools: Renovate for Docker base image updates

applicability_to_chained.justification: Chained uses Node.js 18 (EOL April 2025), Python 3.11/3.12 (EOL 2027/2028), Cloud Run Gen 2. Need proactive tracking of runtime versions and Cloud Run feature lifecycle.
applicability_to_chained.implementation: LOW complexity - 2 hours to create docs/docker-dependencies.md
applicability_to_chained.impact: MEDIUM - prevents emergency migrations (10x cost of planned)

actionable_next_steps: Create: docs/docker-dependencies.md with EOL dates
List: All base images (node:18-alpine, python:3.11-slim, etc.)
Set: Calendar reminders for Node.js 18 EOL (April 2025)
Subscribe: GCP Cloud Run release notes
Template: Migration planning checklist

patterns.name: Container Security as CI/CD Gate
patterns.description: Vulnerability scanning, SBOM generation, and security checks integrated into CI/CD pipeline prevent deployment of vulnerable images. Industry standard in 2025.
patterns.evidence: Industry trend: Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, GCP Artifact Registry all provide integrated scanning. Trivy is de-facto standard open-source scanner. SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) becoming compliance requirement.

strategies: Integrate Trivy into GitHub Actions on every Docker build
Upload scan results to GitHub Security tab
Generate SBOM for all production images
Security scan metrics in monitoring dashboard

applicability_to_chained.justification: Easy integration with existing GitHub Actions workflows. Prevents vulnerable image deployments. Low cost (Trivy is free, open source). Aligns with industry best practices.
applicability_to_chained.implementation: LOW complexity - 4 hours to add Trivy to all Docker build workflows
applicability_to_chained.impact: HIGH - 100% prevention of critical CVE deployments

actionable_next_steps: Add: aquasecurity/trivy-action to .github/workflows/*docker*.yml
Configure: exit-code: 1 to fail build on critical CVEs
Upload: SARIF results to GitHub Security tab
Test: Scan existing production images
Document: CVE handling procedures in docs/

patterns.name: Cloud Run Container Security Hardening
patterns.description: Defense-in-depth strategy combining multi-stage Docker builds, non-root users, minimal base images, Secret Manager integration, and Cloud Run security features.
patterns.evidence: Cloud-native security standards from CNCF, NIST, CIS Docker Benchmark. GCP Cloud Run provides built-in container isolation, automatic HTTPS, managed infrastructure. Best practices: Alpine/distroless bases (50-90% size reduction), non-root user (UID 1001), read-only filesystems.

strategies: Cloud Run ingress controls (internal only for services)

applicability_to_chained.justification: Directly applicable to all 13 Cloud Run services. Current Dockerfiles use alpine/slim bases (good start). Can enhance with multi-stage builds, non-root users, Secret Manager.
applicability_to_chained.implementation: MEDIUM complexity - 1 week to migrate all Dockerfiles
applicability_to_chained.impact: MEDIUM-HIGH - 30-50% image size reduction, significantly reduced attack surface

actionable_next_steps: Migrate: All Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds
Add: Non-root user (RUN addgroup/adduser, USER nodejs)
Create: .dockerignore files for all services
Document: docs/docker-security-standards.md
Template: Secure Dockerfile examples
Review: All services using Secret Manager (not env vars)

technologies.name: Trivy
technologies.description: Open-source vulnerability scanner for containers and IaC. De-facto industry standard for Docker image scanning.
technologies.use_case: Integrate into CI/CD to scan Docker images before deployment
technologies.next_steps: Add aquasecurity/trivy-action to GitHub Actions workflows

technologies.name: GCP Binary Authorization
technologies.description: Image signing and verification service for GCP. Ensures only trusted container images run on Cloud Run.
technologies.use_case: Require signed images for production deployments (high security environments)
technologies.cost: Free for Cloud Run (included in GCP)
technologies.next_steps: Monitor for compliance requirements, evaluate if handling sensitive data

technologies.name: Distroless Base Images
technologies.description: Minimal container images from Google with only application and runtime dependencies. No package manager, shell, or unnecessary tools.
technologies.use_case: Ultra-minimal production container images with 50-90% size reduction
technologies.next_steps: Test distroless for one service (e.g., ADK API), measure benefits

technologies.name: Docker Multi-Stage Builds
technologies.description: Dockerfile feature allowing separate build and runtime stages. Build dependencies not included in final image.
technologies.use_case: Reduce image size, separate build tools from runtime, improve security
technologies.next_steps: Migrate all Dockerfiles to multi-stage pattern

technologies.name: GCP Artifact Registry Vulnerability Scanning
technologies.description: Automatic, continuous vulnerability scanning for Docker images stored in Artifact Registry. Integrated with Container Analysis API.
technologies.use_case: Scan images at rest, detect new CVEs in deployed images, quarantine vulnerable images

technologies.name: SBOM (Software Bill of Materials)
technologies.description: Machine-readable inventory of software components and dependencies in a container image. Emerging compliance requirement.
technologies.use_case: Track dependencies, identify vulnerabilities, comply with regulations
technologies.next_steps: Generate SBOM for one image, evaluate usefulness

decisions_validated.decision: Use GCP Cloud Run for containerized services (vs self-managed Kubernetes)
decisions_validated.evidence: Kubernetes Ingress NGINX retirement shows operational burden of self-managed infrastructure. Cloud Run provides managed security, automatic HTTPS, container isolation without Kubernetes complexity.
decisions_validated.impact: Chained avoids Kubernetes operational burden and deprecation risks

decisions_validated.decision: Use Alpine/slim base images for Docker containers
decisions_validated.evidence: Industry best practice for minimal attack surface. Alpine reduces image size by 50-80% vs full distributions. Distroless is even better (90% reduction).
decisions_validated.impact: Chained's current Docker images already follow best practices. Can enhance with distroless for even better security.

decisions_validated.evidence: Avoids multi-cloud data transfer costs. Related to cloud security theme - keeping all resources in same region improves security boundaries and reduces cost.
decisions_validated.impact: Simplified security model, lower costs, easier compliance

anti_patterns_identified.anti_pattern: Not decommissioning legacy cloud resources (Docker images, old revisions)
anti_patterns_identified.example: Checkout.com legacy cloud storage from 2020 led to security breach
anti_patterns_identified.why_problematic: Old, unmaintained resources accumulate vulnerabilities and become attack vectors
anti_patterns_identified.remedy: Quarterly audits, automated cleanup, documented lifecycle, retention policies

anti_patterns_identified.anti_pattern: Using :latest tag for Docker images in production
anti_patterns_identified.example: Kubernetes and Docker best practices guides universally recommend specific version tags
anti_patterns_identified.why_problematic: Cannot reproduce builds, difficult to rollback, unclear what's actually deployed
anti_patterns_identified.remedy: Use specific version tags (commit SHA, semantic version)

anti_patterns_identified.example: CIS Docker Benchmark, NIST container security guidelines
anti_patterns_identified.why_problematic: Container escape vulnerabilities grant root access to host system
anti_patterns_identified.remedy: Create non-root user (UID 1001), use USER directive in Dockerfile

anti_patterns_identified.anti_pattern: No vulnerability scanning in CI/CD pipeline
anti_patterns_identified.example: Industry standard in 2025 - all major registries provide scanning
anti_patterns_identified.why_problematic: Vulnerable images deployed to production, discovered only after incidents
anti_patterns_identified.remedy: Integrate Trivy/Grype in GitHub Actions, block critical CVEs

priority_high.recommendation: Enable GCP Artifact Registry vulnerability scanning
priority_high.impact: HIGH - continuous scanning of all images

priority_high.recommendation: Add Trivy to GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
Audit and cleanup old Docker images (>180 days)

priority_medium.recommendation: Migrate all Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds
Implement non-root user in all containers
